manual_basis: Installed SIMLOX manual p225 states that item transfer BETWEEN/OUT creates a source-position demand but lateral support is never considered for transfer demands. Lateral support topology and IMMEDIATE policy are defined pp319-326; ItemTransfer source fields pp476-478.
controlled_design: Accept E08.var01 ENLAT=Y native source and append only one h2 BASE-01 to <OUTSIDE> OUT request for one LRU, plus description. BASE-01 initial on-hand0, genuine stocked lateral peer BASE-02 on-hand1, ordinary depot on-hand1. Preserve ordinary demand, lateral policy, TRACK=Y, half-hour ITEM bins, seed and horizon. At h2 no ordinary aircraft item demand has arisen; the accepted E08 parent proves this lateral geometry serves later ordinary demand.
pre_run_hypotheses: The child imports, exactly roundtrips 25 populated authored tables, calculates with zero converter errors and produces nonempty output.

At h2 the OUT request at empty BASE-01 creates a transfer backorder or remains unfulfilled, without drawing BASE-02 physical stock through lateral support, despite ENLAT=Y and the peer spare being on hand.

The peer's physical ID remains at BASE-02 through h2; ordinary aircraft demand later may use lateral support, but transfer backorder interaction and item destination must be observed rather than inferred.
Native physical identities, station STSZ/STOHA/NBO bins, transfer backorder text, system and mission bins, and terminal stock reconcile against the accepted E08 control.
acceptance_gate: Publish only if native log visibly processes the h2 OUT request as a transfer demand, transfer backorder, or unfulfilled transfer task, while the genuine lateral peer remains physically stocked through h2 and no h2 peer-to-base lateral shipment occurs. An absent h2 transfer action alone is not proof. The child must also be a valid source-bound native run. If the transfer consumes a peer spare, reject the no-lateral hypothesis; if converter errors or report gaps occur, retain diagnostic only.
limits: one OUT request at h2 with zero local on-hand and one peer spare
one IID, LAT-01 IMMEDIATE DLAYL=N, one depot and one seed
no general priority, all transfer types, competing peer choice, GUI visual or cross-engine claim
